source.label: the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc d does not transit

controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by 55 Cnc; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured color.
controls.notes: No image or color of 55 Cnc d is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the color of hd-75732's light, as its color dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of 55 Cnc's planets in this map from above, to scale, with 55 Cnc d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

physical.credit: Radius from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since 55 Cnc d does not transit; mass from Xiao et al. (2026), Table 4: 3.23 (+0.29, -0.30) Jupiter masses, the true mass from radial velocities joined with Hipparcos and Gaia astrometry; orbit from Xiao et al. (2026), Table 4, a joint fit of radial velocities with Hipparcos and Gaia astrometry (the time of conjunction alone is Moutou et al. 2026, A&A 705, A190, because Xiao et al. print no epoch; a/R* is their 5.58 au over the star's recorded 656,045 km)
